title: Get search request for backend usage

comments.body:
So we already have the feature, in the form of the `getQuery` [method on the helper](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/blob/f4dab89dcce68d46596d5b8a5e88f18f28b13330/src/algoliasearch.helper.js#L160-L163). However it is poorly named and will create confusions with `setQuery`.

 - [ ] Make sure it works with `browseAll` (or document which feature/methods it should be used with)
 - [ ] Rename the method
 - [ ] Document it
